name: capell-app/widget-before-after
description: Your before photo and after photo as one picture, with a slider visitors move to reveal the change.

healthChecks.label: Before and After widget package health

marketplace.summary: A before and after photo comparison with labels and a slider, shown as two side-by-side photos if scripts are blocked.
marketplace.description: Upload a before photo and an after photo, give each a short label and a description for screen readers, and they become one picture with a slider. You pick where the split starts, halfway by default, and whether the after photo comes in from the left or from the top. Visitors drag it with a finger or mouse, and keyboard users move it with the arrow keys. Photos aren't cropped or aligned for you. Both must be uploaded to the Capell media library. Without JavaScript, the photos still show side by side. It needs Layout Builder to place it on a page.
marketplace.problem: Two photos side by side don't show how much changed, so finished work gets scrolled past.
marketplace.outcome: Visitors move a slider under one picture and see exactly what your work changed.

faq.question: How do visitors compare the photos?
faq.answer: They drag the slider bar under the picture with a finger or a mouse, or move it with the arrow keys. It begins halfway across unless you set another starting point.

faq.question: Can I use photos from another website?
faq.answer: No. Both photos have to be uploaded to your own site.

faq.question: Does it crop or line up my photos?
faq.answer: No. It leaves them as they are, so two shots of the same size taken from the same spot compare best.

faq.question: What if a visitor's browser blocks scripts?
faq.answer: They see both photos next to each other, each with its label. The slider bar still shows underneath but does not change the picture.

faq.question: Can one page hold several comparisons?
faq.answer: Yes. Each comparison holds one pair of photos, and a page can carry as many comparisons as you add.
